headline: The PCB on Saturday awarded central contracts to 38 men's cricketers for November 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027 under a new five-track system, with Mohammad Rizwan, Shan Masood and Saim Ayub among the notable omissions, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Naye contracts 1 Nov 2026 se 30 June 2027 tak

caption:
PCB ke naye central contracts, Rizwan, Shan aur Saim list se bahar! 🏏
Dawn ke mutabiq PCB ne Saturday ko 38 cricketers ko central contracts diye, jo 1 November 2026 se 30 June 2027 tak hain. A se D grades ki jagah ab 5 tracks hain: Test aur ODI (Babar Azam, Salman Ali Agha), Test, ODI aur T20I, T20I aur Development, jis mein 19 khilari hain. Mohammad Rizwan, Shan Masood, Saim Ayub, Hasan Ali aur Abdullah Shafique ko contract nahi mila. Aaqib Javed ke mutabiq list se bahar khilari bhi qaumi team ke liye ab bhi chune ja sakte hain.
In contracts par aap ka kya khayal hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
